decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-0f02d884374d], is a one-line changelog entry saying "BREAKING CHANGE: refactor how we do defaults for runtime overrides" with a link to PR 12448. It doesn't name the config keys or components affected, or give a before/after behaviour or change type. It also doesn't say what happens to an operator who does nothing, so subject, change, applicability and consequence can't be written. We need the PR diff, the upgrade-guide section or the docs describing how runtime-override defaults now work.
